description: The project file of Alloy. Every key has a default, and an unknown key is an error.

build.description: What compiles, and where the output goes.

artifact.description: Which artifact to write. `ship` runs on Roblox; `check` is what luau-lsp sees, with the types kept.

clean.description: Delete an output whose source is gone.

exclude.description: Glob patterns, relative to `in`, of sources to skip.

in.description: The source root. Every `.aly` and `.alx` under it compiles, relative to the folder that holds this file.

out.description: The output root. The tree under `in` is mirrored under it, and the runtime is written beside it as `alloy.luau`.

build.title: [build]

emit.description: The few knobs that change what emitted code does.

erase_type_imports.description: Blank `import type` lines in the output so they add no runtime dependency. The output is then untyped for anyone who analyzes it directly.

std_require.description: The string emitted code passes to `require` for the runtime. Unset means a relative path to the `alloy.luau` the build writes, or the instance path through the mounts.

wait_timeout.description: Seconds passed to every `WaitForChild` that `=>` emits. Unset means no timeout: the engine waits forever and warns after five seconds. With a timeout the call can return nil, so `=>` guards like `->`.

emit.title: [emit]

flux.description: What `alloy flux` runs beyond the lints, and the limits of the complexity lints. The levels of the lints stay in `[lint]`. `alloy doc flux` explains it.

cognitive_complexity.description: `cognitive_complexity` fires past this score: one per branch, loop, `and`, `or`, and ternary, plus the depth of each branch.

definitions.description: Definitions files for the type check, `.d.luau` or `.d.aly`, relative to this file. The project's `.d.aly` files join them on their own.

luau_lsp.description: The luau-lsp binary. Unset means `luau-lsp` on the PATH, then `~/.alloy/bin` and `~/.ember/bin`.

max_nesting.description: `deep_nesting` fires past this many nested blocks.

roblox_types.description: Load the Roblox globals. The file comes from the luau-lsp extension's storage, or downloads once into `~/.alloy/types`.

security_level.description: The security level of the Roblox globals.

too_many_arguments.description: `too_many_arguments` fires past this many parameters; `self` does not count.

too_many_lines.description: `too_many_lines` fires past this many lines in one function.

typecheck.description: Run luau-lsp over the check artifact and report its type errors on the source lines.

flux.title: [flux]

fmt.description: How Anneal, `alloy fmt`, lays code out. The names follow larvae and stylua where the option is theirs; `alloy doc fmt` explains each.

align_struct_fields.description: Alloy's own: the `:` of a struct's fields line up.

alx.description: The markup of `.alx` files, after luaux-worm. The code around it formats like any `.aly` file.

attribute_per_line.description: A tag that breaks its attributes puts every attribute on its own line, rather than as many as fit.

attribute_quotes.description: The quotes of a string attribute: `Name="x"`. `quote_style` does not govern it.

blank_lines.description: A blank line between two children stays.

bracket_same_line.description: The `>` of a tag that broke its attributes sits on the last attribute's line rather than its own.

text_wrap.description: `fill` reflows text children to the column width; `preserve` keeps the author's line breaks.

alx.title: [fmt.alx]

block_newline_gaps.description: A blank line right after a block opener or right before its closer: dropped, or kept.

call_chains.description: How a chain of method calls breaks.

min_calls.description: The number of calls a chain needs before it breaks; 0 breaks only what runs past the width.

style.description: `method` breaks before each call past the first, `full` before every call, once the chain holds `min_calls` calls. `preserve` keeps the author's lines.

call_chains.title: [fmt.call_chains]

call_parentheses.description: The parentheses of a call with one string or one table argument: `f("x")` and `f "x"`. `input` keeps what the author wrote.

collapse_simple_statement.description: Whether `if c then return end` or a function with one statement may sit on one line.

column_width.description: The width a bracket group breaks past: a call, a table, or an array that does not fit goes one element per line.

exclude.description: Paths the formatter leaves alone. A `*` matches any run of characters: `"vendor/*"`, `"*.gen.aly"`.

expand_imports.description: Alloy's own: an `import { }` or `export { }` list with more than one name breaks one name per line. Off, a trailing comma in the list asks for the same.

indent_width.description: Spaces per level, when `indent_type` is spaces.

leading_zero.description: `.5` and `0.5`: add the zero, strip it, or leave the literal.

line_endings.description: The line ending of the written file.

magic_trailing_comma.description: A trailing comma in the source keeps its group expanded, one element per line, whatever the width.

quote_style.description: The quotes of a string literal. An `auto` style keeps the other quote for a string that holds the preferred one; `force` escapes instead.

sort_requires.description: Sorting of the `import` lines at the top of a file.

enabled.description: Sort the run of `import` statements at the top of the file by path.

grouping.description: `by-kind` orders `@alias` paths first, then absolute ones, then relative ones; `flat` sorts by path alone.

sort_requires.title: [fmt.sort_requires]

space_after_function_names.description: Where a space goes before the `(` of a function: `function f ()` in definitions, `f ()` in calls.

space_inside_array.description: Alloy's own: `[ 1, 2 ]` rather than `[1, 2]` in an array literal.

trailing_comma.description: An expanded table or array ends its last element with a comma.

fmt.title: [fmt]

lint.description: The level of each lint under `alloy flux` and `alloy lint`. A list takes a lint name or a group name: correctness, suspicious, style, complexity, perf, roblox, pedantic, naming, or luau for the type checker's own. A name beats its group. `alloy doc lints` names them.

allow.description: Lints or groups that stay silent.

deny.description: Lints or groups that fail the run.

strict.description: Turns the pedantic group on, at warn: `implicit_any`, `missing_return_type`, `explicit_any`, `todo_comment`, `print_debug`, `missing_doc`.

warn.description: Lints or groups that print and pass.

lint.title: [lint]

additionalProperties.description: The path on disk, relative to this file, and the DataModel location as `@game/Service/Folder`. A `.server.` or `.client.` file name picks the script class; `init` names its directory.

items.description: The folder on disk, relative to this file.

mount.description: Where each folder lands in the DataModel: `alias = [path, mount]`. The folder at `path` lands at `mount`, `require("@alias/x")` resolves through it, and with one or more mounts `alloy build` writes `default.project.json` over the sources and `.alloy/build.project.json` over the output.
mount.title: [mount]

project.description: The Rojo project the mounts describe.

runtime.description: Where `alloy.luau` mounts. Emitted code requires it by a relative instance path from each file's mount.

sourcemap.description: Write `.alloy/sourcemap.json` on every build. The language server reads it for `@game/` completion and instance types.

project.title: [project]

test.description: Where `alloy test` writes the specs: one lest spec per source with a `@test`, with everything the tests reach. `alloy doc test` explains it.

lest.description: Write `lest.toml` and the `@lest` alias of `.luaurc` when the root has none.

out.description: The folder the specs land in, relative to this file. Each source with a `@test` writes `<out>/<path>.spec.luau`.

test.title: [test]

title: alloy.toml
